title: wissadula trilobata
intro: Wissadula trilobata, commonly known as Cut Leaved Sida, is a plant species in the mallow family, Malvaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues, due to its health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Wissadula trilobata include its ability to reduce fever, relieve pain, and soothe digestive issues, making it a popular remedy in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and therapeutic actions.
